tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag len rim pa ji lta ba'i gtor chog bzhugs so// na mo mañdzu gho ṣa ā nan+da puṇ+ya ya/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i bsgrub pa pos yi dam chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa/ blo gsar ba rnams dpe tshol bde ba'i phyir sa lo chen po'i phyag len bzhin bkod pa la/ gnas khang yid du 'ong bar yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bris sku yod na zhal shar ram lhor phyogs par dgram/ de'i mdun du stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa ras la sogs pas bkab pa la/ 'bru sna tshogs bcal du bkram pa'i steng du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis sam bcu gcig la sogs pa dmigs sha ma yin pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga gtsang zhing bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ gtor ma'i kha grangs 'byor pa dang bstun rang rang gi lugs bzhin bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mdun du/ rdo rje dril bu dang nang mchod la sogs pa nyer bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang ma tshang ba med par bshams la/ rang gang byed pa'i yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dhar+m+maḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdung pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du gau las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/

shar du bh+rūṃ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas/ oṃ dang rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas/ rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥzhes gsum mam lngar brjod de byin gyis rlabs la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum gsum brtseg gi nang du paṃ paṃ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad re re/

steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du bh+riṃ gi ri ti/ byang shar du gzhon nu kirti ka ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ bar gyi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar dbus su hūm̐ las dpal kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi bla gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/

/rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar du gaṃ las gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsaṃ las tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu baṃ las bet+ta li ser mo g.yas ru sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghaṃ las ghasma ri ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du paṃ las puk+ka si sngon po g.yas seṅge/ g.yon dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor shaṃ las ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong / g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu laṃ las gdol pa mo sngon dmar g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong shol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ḍaṃ las g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan te thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/

'og gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyongs/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di dag thams cad pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la thim/ sa steng na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la thim/ sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la thim/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kye rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang se gol gyi sgras spyan drangs/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bet+ta lī ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing /

/puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdungs/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bor nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha ba ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bet+ta lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa li la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍom+bhi nī la 'od dpag med/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan par bsam la/ oṃ bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai bi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ mahā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas chu bzhi phul/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma drangs te gsol bar bsam zhing / pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ bha ga wan sogs nas sa pa ri wā ra oṃ in+da/

dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhu ta/ ba hin bā u/ rak+kha/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā da/ paspa/ ta la pā ta le/ aṣ+ṭa saspa swāhā/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhū pa/ sing gha/ am+bha/ saspa/ kadz+dza/ sā da/ khun+ti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a d+ya nut+pan+nā twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod cing se gol gdab/ de lta bu gsum mam lnga la sogs pas gtor ma phul la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes dang mthe bo'i thor nas nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo dang / dril bu gsum brdung bya zhing / dkar mo ri dwags sogs nas 'khyud pa nyid ces pa dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ /khyod kyi rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje sgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyi dges/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro༞ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro༞ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro༞ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/

/bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ rdo rje thugs kar bzung / dril bu chig brdungs bya zhing / lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams༞ /'byung po'i༞ /yi dwags༞ /sha za'i༞ /smyo byed༞ /brjed byed༞ /mkha' 'gro'i༞ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrung / /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces 'phrin las gzhol/ gtor ma gzhan rnams kyi byin rlabs sngar dus gcig la grub zin yang / byin rlabs dran pas phyir/ bde mchog gi gtor ma la lag pa g.yon bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan te āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che bas dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ skad cig gis mdun gyis nam mkhar bsrung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su/

gtso bo yab yum/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ dur khrod brgyad la phog pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo cha brgyad du gyur/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ sngags skyes/ zhing skyes/ lhan skyes kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor thams cad phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor cha dgur gyur/ de thams cad kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ pad skor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥḍā ki ni sa mā ya satwaṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ aṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ i maṃ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ma kar+ya sā dhā ya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ swāhā/ lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ rgyas par na lha sngags yongs rdzogs tshar gcig brjod pas kyang 'bul bar bshad do/ /bsdu na oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru gnyis/ ban+dha gnyis/ trā sa ya gnyis/ k+ṣo bha ya gnyis/ hrauṃ gnyis/ hraḥganyis/ phaiṃ gnyis/ phaṭa gnyis/ da ha gnyis/ pa tsa gnyis/ bhak+ṣa gnyis/ ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba lam+bi ne/ gṛh+na gnyis/ sap+ta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzaṅga/ sarbaṃ bā/ tardza ya gnyis/ a kar+dha gnyis/ hriṃ gnyis/ dzo ṇoṃ gnyis/ k+ṣ+maṃ gnyis/ haṃ gnyis/ hiṃ gnyis/ hūm̐ gnyis/ ki li gnyis/ si li gnyis/ hi li gnyis/ dhi li gnyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo ste phyi mchod/ hūm̐ baṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ pu dza au a go ra de ma ka o tri ko ka la ka hi pre gri sau su na/ si ma ku/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swāhā hu/ bo ṣaṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa haṃ/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yaṃ/ hrī/ moṃ/ hreṃ/ hreṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces pas nang mchod/ gang ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la/

na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / smon lam gyi dbang gi 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig se gol gcig gtogs/ yang sngar gyi phyag rgya snying gar bcas la/ oṃ sarba bit+pa pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā bar+dha ya/ ā bar+dha ya hoḥ na maḥs mān+ta bud+dha nan/ a bi sma ye/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu/ a kā sha sa man+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ par+ṣad+da la/ maṇ+ḍa la/ ma ma pra ṇi dha na/ pu ṇ+ye dzña na ba le na sarba ta thā ga ta ban+dha ni/ swas+d+ya ba le na tsa swāhā/ phyag rgya bkrol la se gol lan gnyis su gtogs pas yid mchod/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bi re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+na san+ni bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka tra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭa ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa na mu kha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha pra bhū dza bhā su rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pa sho d+ya ta shu la kha ṭ+wāṅga dhā ri ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bha ya gh+rā dzi nām+ba ra dha rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhum bran+dha ka ra ba pu ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yab kyi rkang brgyad do/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wa ra hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya ma te mahā bi d+ya shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mas+sar+b+ba bhu ta bhā ya bā h+ya ma hā dz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa ra dzi te bā shaṅka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ na mo bi ṣa sho ṣa ni/ ro ṣa ṇi/ kro dha ni ka rā li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mas+san+t+ra sa ni/ mā ra ṇi/ su tra bhe da ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ pa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye/ bi dza ye/ dzam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni/ ma he ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā ra hi/ ma hā yo ga ni/ kā ma ེshwa ri/ kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'o/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa 'joms/ /khyed kyi dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan/ /mgon po thugs rje'i char gyis yang dag slan pa'i thugs kyi chus/ /lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu dgyes brtse mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥzhes phyag rgya dang bcas pa gong bzhin brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag che zhing cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gser gyi gaṇ+ḍe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags bsgril ba dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis klub pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stang kyi ro yi steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag

rgyab na ce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du ṭaṃ las e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pas rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang pos ske rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang / g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang / thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrogs pa/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas yaṃ/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las/ yaṃ las nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags kyi gri gug g.yon par ba gdengs pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' dang / mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa/ maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon par ba gdengs pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/

byi ru'i lan tshar can/ yab las triḥtriḥdang yum las bh+yoḥspros pa las pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ triḥlas las kyi mgon po pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa lcags kyi ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi aṅga rag dang / dar nag gi na bzas brgyan pa/ triḥlas bha ṭa nag po stag slog can g.yas gsher shing gi dam shing dang / g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ bh+yoḥlas sring mo khrag mig ma kha nas me 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas spu gri/ g.yon mi'i rgyu ma 'dzin zhing / za 'og na tra'i gos gyon pa lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dang / mi mgo skam pos dbu rgyan dang / dgra bgegs kyi rgyu ma brgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal can/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa'i skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren dge slong mkhar gsil thogs pa brgya/ rgyab kyi ru 'dren sngags nag ban phur 'dzin pa brgya/ mdun gyi shul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo par ba gdengs pa brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag ce spyang / mi nag la sogs pa'i pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ bh+yoḥ yaṃ/ maṃ/ tri/ tri/ bh+yoḥ rnams las 'od 'phros 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi pho brang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas mgon po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum lha mo'i mkhar sogs nas lha mo/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las mgon pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang se gol gyi sgra bya/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug pas mgon po'i dam rgya bcas te/ mdzub mo g.yab pa'am/ rdo rjes g.yab cing dril bu bcad btubs su dkrol la/ hūm̐ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/

/da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang sor mo phan tshun cung zad bsnol ba'i rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu bzhag pa lha mo'i dam rgya g.yab pa'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha mo kun gshegs༞ da lta༞ gshegs shing༞ shākya'i༞ bdag cag༞ gnas 'dir༞ yang mgon po'i dam rgya'i g.yab pa'am/ dril bu 'dzin pas/ las mgon kun gshegs༞ da lta༞ gshegs shing༞ shākya'i༞ bdag cag༞ gnas 'di/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wī+i/ sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ gdan dbul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha swāhā/ de nas chos skyong gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ lha mo'i dam rgya bcas la/ ma hā kā li de wī/ mgon po'i dam rgya bzhin bcas la/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ badz+ra kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra/ bha ṭa/ ru lu rak+kha si/ sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya ma ti pra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig bsrung / bstan pa skyong ba/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bdag gi lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyis bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/

/gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la ……thal mo gdab cing gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing dpa' skong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing / bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing dam la bzhag rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wi sa pa ri wā ra/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ/ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba l+ya di swāhā/ lnga'am bdun dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ shā sa no pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pash+tsi ma ka lo/ ya mi daṃ/ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ri ṇaṃ/ ya ti twaṃ/ pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭan/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ oṃ ro ru ro ru/ bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba dho si/ ka ma la rak+kha si hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā ka li de wi sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong ltar mchod/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes mgon po dang / de nas lha mo la/ oṃ ro ru sogs kyi mjug tu gong ltar 'bru gsum brjod pas nang mchod phul te/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma mgon po'i skabs ltar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ

phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs dran par byas la/ mgon po'i g.yas su pad+ma nyi ma/ mi ro'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po ro za ba/ steng zhal dud kha mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug g.yon dang po na thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri 'phyar thabs/ g.yon gnyis pa na rus phreng / chang gi gang ba'i bum pa mchan khung du 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga lnga'i dbu la brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ sbrul dang rgyu ma rlon pa'i tshangs skud/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs/ zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang ba gdan ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ drag la rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ ngag tu hā hā dang / hūm̐ hūm̐ dang / k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gi sgra sgrogs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du sring mo dmar nag rgyab tu siṅga li ser nag thams cad gcer bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lnga ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ti se bsil ba'i tshal/ po tā la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang / kha'u'i brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas dpal gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya zhal gyi dam rgya bcas te mdzub mo gnyis g.yab pa'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/

/gtum po khyod kyi ji ltar khas blangs ltar/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā daṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ ces pas mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bcas te/ de'i spyi bor bzhag par bsam la/ oṃ mā hā kā la tsa turmu khā sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya sma ra si sogs gong mgon po'i skabs ltar gyi dam la bzhag la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs gong bzhin gyi bka' bsgos la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta ḍoṃ bhi nī tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+kha sī siṅgha lī/ de wī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te/ zhes sogs btags pa gsum mam lnga dang / spro na sngags ring gis kyang phul/ oṃ mahā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong ltar mchod/ nang mchod phul te/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la sogs nas de wi hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes sogs gong mgon po'i skabs ltar 'phrin las bcol/ de nas dur khrod bdag po'i gtor ma gong ltar byin rlabs dran par byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las e mched pas nam mkhar rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ su las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keng las keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri rab/ de'i steng du thod pa skam po'i gzhal med khang khrag gi chag chag btab cing / glo snying rgyu ma'i drwa phyed 'phan tshar can/ zhing lpags kyi bla re bris pa'i dbus su/

pa pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang aṃ las dung dang mgron bu/ hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ keng rus shin tu 'jigs pa'i tshul can/ spyan bgrad cing ljags 'gril ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas thod skam gyis dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bsnams shing gsol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rin po che'i snyan cha 'khyil ba/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas dur khrod bdag po yab yum la sha za ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i don mdzad pa/ /dad ldan dam tshig chen po yi/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sha ma sha na sa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ skad cig gi dbang gi lha 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa re res dbu brgyan/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya snying khar bcas la/ badz+ra sa mā ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra sa mā ya hoḥ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig bsrung / bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang /

bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar gcod pa dang / tshe ring ba dang / nad med pa/ longs spyod 'phel ba/ chom rkun mtha' dag bcing ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ gṛ ha rā dza/ gṛ ha rā dza/ ku ma ku ma/ khum thi ma hā pi sha tsi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba sid+dhim+p+re yats+tshan+tu swāhā/ tshar lnga/ oṃ sh+ma sha na pa ti a r+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ dpal dur khrod bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob la/ /chos kyi bar chad nyer zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen ma lus 'bad med du/ /'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas las mgon gyi gtor ma la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin rlabs dran par byas nas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ a li a li ma dza dza/ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a shi ded/ mo rmugs spu gri a li ma dza dza/ nag mo sha la rub dza dza/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la/ a shug me/ ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdza dzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trun bigh+nan mā rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum mam bdun gyi phul la/ gong ltar phyi mchod dang / oṃ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣaḥ kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha ṭa/ ru lu rak+kha si/ sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul te/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' stod pu tra ming sring / 'khor du ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ pho nya las mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes sogs gong ltar brjod cing 'phrin las bcol lo/

/de nas dkar bdud kyi gtor ma la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum brjod pas byin rlabs dran par byas nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ bh+yoḥdakar mo yongs su gyur pa las/ dkar mo nyi zla stong gi phreng ba can sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas ri rab sgong rdor 'phen zhing / g.yon pas gling bzhi byo ldog tu mdzad pa/ nyi zla brgya yis dbu la brgyan zhing / nyi zla dgu brgyas do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar dkar po'i na bza' can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yon du rta nag po'i steng du/ hūm̐ las bdud kyi rgyal po thod pa'i phreng ba can/ sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags bsgril ba/ phyag g.yas pas ba dan nag po mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa ru phreng 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' can mi mgo'i phreng ba dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ 'khor 'chi bdag nag po rang dang 'dra ba brgyad kyi bskor ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza/ hūm̐ che ba'i che mchog gsang ba'i gzugs/ /thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod 'phreng can/ /srog bdag bdud kyis rgyal po yang / /gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing / dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbu brgyan/

de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod phreng 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig bsrung / bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar bcad pa dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ badz+ra shan+tiṃ pad+ma kurti bh+yoḥ oṃ sarba mā kriṣ+ṭa kā pā la ma la dha ra sa pa ri wā i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trun bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum mam lngas gtor ma phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shan+tiṃ ku ru/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ wa shaṃ ku ru/ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes pas nang mchod phul nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ bla ma rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas phur bsrung dam can bcu gnyis kyi gtor ma la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyi byin rlabs dran par byas nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i bsrung mar zhal bzhes pa/ /bdag nyid chen po shwa na se mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/

/dam tshig dbang gi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li ki la ya/ dha ti ma ma shrī gh+raṃ karma ka ra ma ra se na pra mar+dha ni sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yang sa pa ri wa ra yan gyi rjes su/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha/ khā hi kha hi/ sogs lan gsum mam lnga yi gtor ma phul la/ nang mchod gtor zhing / ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi/ phur bsrung dam can bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs gong ltar brjod/ de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin rlabs dran par byas nas/ lag pa'i mdzub mo gnyis lu gu brgyud du sbrel/ mthe bong gnyis dang gung mo gnyis so sor sbyar/ sor mo lhag ma rnams 'bar ba ltar byas pa dpral ba'i steng du g.yon du bskor/ gdong bsgyur zhing mig gyen du lta ba dang bcas pas/ phaiṃ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyi 'dzam bu'i gling na gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad dang / de na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam la/ de rnams la gtor ma phul bar bsam ste/ thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsi/ un ma da/ a pa smā ra ḍā kā ḍā ki n+yā dā ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+nan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ li pa tha/ mā ti pra ma thā/ ma ma sarba kārta yā/ sad su ka bi shud+dhe/ sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe sogs nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod phul te/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i dam pa chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod/ de nas/ gzhi bdag gtor ma la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs dran par byas la/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo g.yab cing / bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ces pas gzhi thob pa rnams spyan drangs par bsam la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/ bhu mi pa ti'i mjug tu a ka ru btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyi phul/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod gtor la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag skor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /gsol lo/ /sbyin no/ /bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thog mar dpon slob thams cad kyi dam tshig nyams chag sbyang ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ de nas mgo gnon gyi phyir/ de wa pi tsu ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ bzlas pa gang byed pa'i sngags 'od zer bcas pa 'phros/ mgon po sogs de dang de'i thugs khar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ gang bsgo ba nyan par bsam la/

mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma/ bcu gnyis ma/ shā sa na/ lha mo'i ro ru/ zhal gyi sngags thung spro zhing shes na sngags ring / dur khrod bdag po'i gṛ ha rā dza/ las mgon gyi bod pa gnyis/ dkar bdud/ phur bsrung sogs kyi sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ bzlas pa rdzogs pa na/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ sa pa ri bā ra gṛh+ne daṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod dbul zhing / 'phrin las bcol rgyas bsdus blo dang bstun nas 'dod don gsol gdab bya/ de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi las dang / nyon mongs pa dang / mi shes pa dang / ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / snyoms las kyi dbang du gyur pa'i rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba bgyis pa dang / dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang / dam tshig ma dag pa dang / tshogs 'dres pa dang / spyod yul gcig tu gyur pa dang / bsnyen pa dang bsgrub pa la ma brtson pa dang / bsrung ma khyad par can khyed rnams dus dus su ma mchod cing ma gsol ba'i dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag tu gyur pa dang / khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa de dag thams cad/ spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas thugs rje dang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /mkha' la sprin dengs pa'am/ rgya mtsho la rlabs zhi ba ltar nongs pa spyad pa dang / de'i 'bras bu thams cad med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig

sngags dang phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyi rlabs pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 'di dang / rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'dis/ dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi thugs dam bskong bar gyur cig bzhed pa 'grub par gyur cig re ba rdzogs par gyur cig de ltar gyur nas kyang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang / gdon dang / rims dang / bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dgra dang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad gzhom du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba dang / dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces pa lan gsum mam gcig khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod/ /dges pa chen po'i sgo phye la/ /dngos grub 'phrin las bdud rtsi yis/ /rgyun gyi bdag rgyud bltams par mdzod/ /lan gsum/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /tshangs par stsal du gsol/ yon tan kun rdzogs dngos grub mnga' ba'i lha/ /ma lus rmad byung 'phags pa'i dgongs pa can/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i/ /legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol/

/sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyis/ /spyi dang khyad par gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams/ /bsrung bar dam bcas 'da' rgyu ma lags na/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi/ /bag med tshul gyi dam la 'gal ba rnams/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dang spyi 'gal ba/ /dpal mgon bsrung ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /ces brjod/ de nas bskang gso byed na/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ so so'i gzhung bzhin rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun nas byed/ bskang gso'i mjug gam bskang gso mi byed na/ bshags pa'i mjug tu mgon po/ lha mo/ zhal gsum gyi sngags thung brjod la/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang 'dod bya/ yang rgyun gyi nyams len bsdus pa la spro na/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba po/ /mgon po gri gug thod pa can/ /kha dog gnag cing ro la zhon/ /nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo re ba ti/ /srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing / /'dod khams mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mchog /dus mtshan nag mo khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur ba/ /nag po chen po mi zad gtsigs/ /mchu 'phyang shugs che byis pa'i gzugs/ /drag po'i sgra sgrogs khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ dur khrod sha za kun gyi gtso/ /rab dkar keng rus brjid pa'i sku/ /dam tshig can la rtser dgongs pa'i/ /nor gyi bdag po yab yum bstod/ /nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa'i/ /bstan bsrung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang / /bstan 'dzin sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /'jig rten bde zhing skyid par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas te/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥdapal ldan dkar mo nyi zla ni/ /dar dkar 'jol ber sku la gsol/

/ri rab gling bzhi phyag na bsnams/ /skye 'gro gso mdzad khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ dpal chen bka' yi pho nya ni/ /rlung gi shugs can bdud rta'i steng / /mdog nag ru mtshon thod phreng can/ /bdud rgyal nag po khyod la bstod/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /spyan sngar khas blangs bdag nyid ma/ /shwa na mu kha'i bse mo bzhi/ /phur bsrung rnams la bstod par bgyi/ /lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gis bar brjod/ kol+la e reṭa thi a bo lā/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha ṇe kri si ṭa ho bādz+dza i/ kā ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ bā la khadz+dza i/ ga dhaiṃ ma a ṇa pidz+dza i/ ha le kā le dza ra sa ṇa a i/ dun+du ra bādz+dzi a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu rī sih+la/ kā pu ra la i a i/ mā la in+dha na sa liñdza/ ta hiṃ bha ru kha i a i/ phaiṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ṇi a i/ ni raṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ni a i/ mā la a dze kun+du ru bā ṭa i/ ḍin+ḍi ma ta hi na badz+dzi a i/ zhes pas rdo rje'i glu dang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan snga ba/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de yis nye bar bsten pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/

/zhes bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyi grol gyur bar/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces smon lam btab/ de nas gtor ma 'bul na steng ngam gnas de nyid nas phul kyang rung ste/ mgon po lcam dral dang / zhal gyi sngags thung brjod la/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā ka la dang / /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /ma rung las mdzad yum chen sring mo bzhi/ /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad༞ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' lding ce spyang bya khyi༞ /pu tra la sogs las mkhan༞ /ye shes mgon po dkar bdud༞ /bsrung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'dir bzhugs gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dzaṃ bu ṭi ba'i zhal zas༞ /sman raka phud kyi mchod pa༞ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol legs pa'i gsal 'debs chen por bzhes/ /dpon slob bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di khyod kyi sgrub/ /bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces dang / gtor sngags rnams brjod cing las bzhi'i dmigs pa gang 'dod dang 'phrin las rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas byed/

bskang gso yod na dang / med na dam rdzas yi dam bzhag la gtor ma gzhan rnams khang stengs su las kyi rdo rjes phyag len bzhin phul/ de nas hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bsam pa'i don rnams chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ /dpal mgon ma hā kā la'i gzi brjid dang / /lha chen nag po gdong bzhi'i mthu rtsal dang / /las mgon pho nya rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi/ /gnas mchog 'dir yang bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /ces brjod/ de nas oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dri d+dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñdza he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad nas/ lus ngag yid gsum la sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing / lhag chad kha skor bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bstan par bzhugs su gsol/

bye brag du yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams/ 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gis gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing nas la sogs pa rten rnams la gtor/ gtor mgron gyi rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi rten med na gshegs gsol mi rung bas gsang rten byed kyi yod na de la dang / med na mdun gyi mgon po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ ces brjod pa man ngag dam pa yin no/ /rang nyid kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma'i bar dang / 'gro ba thams cad kye rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /ces brjod/ 'di ni kye rdor gyi bdag bskyed byas pa'i dbang du bcug pa yin la/ gzhan bde mchog phur pa sogs yi dam gzhan gyi bdag bskyed byas na de dag dang 'brel ba'i go bgo ba sogs skabs thob shes dgos so/ /de nas dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yi nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du sgrub nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar/

/skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po/ /rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang / /grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkha' la bsgrin/ /rnam par dag cing rgyud gcig la/ /skal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te/ /thos nas legs bshad ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod paṇa bcings/ /lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyi zung 'jug bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing / /sgrub la bar chad med pa dang / /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces brjod/ bkra shis ni/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas/ /mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran kyang rung / /bkra shis des kyang skye rgu bde legs shog /pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid/ /yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /bkra shis des kyang skye rgu bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs med rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gi gzugs kyi skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /hūm̐ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa'i sku/ /hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro 'brug stong lding ba'i gsung / /spros pa nyer zhi mkha' dbyings chen po'i thugs/ /dpal mgon mahā kā la'i bkra shis shog /gang gi mthu yis brgya byin wa ltar zhum/ /ming tsam thos pas nad do cog las skyobs/

/mtshan mo khams gsum nyul ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /ma gcig srid gsum bdag mo'i bkra shis shog /dpa' brjid mi sdug mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal/ /ral pa dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /ljags kyi dbang po klog ltar 'khrug pa can/ /zhing skyong gdong pa bzhi pa'i bkra shis shog /sprul pa bye bas sa gsum khyab par 'gengs/ /bdud dpung tshar gcod bsgrub la dngos grub stsol/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa/ /pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi bkra shis shog /byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /nor gyi bdag po ar+ya dzam+bha la/ /dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma/ /nor lha chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang / /'dod pa grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shog /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bde legs stsol/ /'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba bzhin du spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rgyal nas/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyi 'byor pa'i dpal dam pa thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog dor ro/ /'di lta bu'i gtor bsngos kyi rim pa'i kye rdor gyi gtor bsngo sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa ltar dang / bde mchog gur zhal/ dur khrod bdag po/ las mgon/ dkar bdud/ phur bsrung sogs sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i mdzad pa bzhin las mdzad byang sogs bzhag pa tsam yin la/ gzhan mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs gong 'og gi cho ga'i chings sgrig chags 'di rnams dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyi thugs dam bsgrig rim ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/
